name: FLUX.3 [klein] 5.6B Base
note: [FLUX.3 [klein] 5.6B Base](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-base) is the undistilled checkpoint of FLUX.3 [klein] 5.6B, trained without step or guidance distillation and intended for fine-tuning, LoRA training and research. It handles text-to-image generation, single-reference editing and multi-reference composition in one model. Provide up to 10 reference images through the canvas and moodboard, or omit images for text-to-image. Write full scene captions covering framing, subject, background and lighting; short prompts give generic output. Unlike FLUX.3 [klein] 5.6B, it requires classifier-free guidance; start with 50 steps, Text Guidance 4 and Shift 16.
